record.question: India's longest tunnel, the Chenani-Nashri Tunnel is located in
record.explanation: Answer C: Jammu and Kashmir. The PMO’s 30 March 2017 announcement places the Chenani–Nashri road tunnel in the then State of Jammu and Kashmir. Historical/source note: Longest refers to the contemporary road/highway category, not every present road or rail tunnel. Retain the 2018 state geography. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1486248&lang=2&reg=48. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
